question: Should gateway JSON `message` and media `reason` fields be localized display text, or should they stay stable English/protocol-facing strings while only chat/UI display copy is localized?
rationale: The PR intentionally localizes gateway-facing strings, but repository policy treats gateway/protocol and compatibility surfaces as merge-sensitive, and code review cannot infer whether existing clients depend on those strings.

options.title: Keep Gateway Fields Stable
options.body: Localize chat/UI display copy while keeping gateway JSON message/reason strings stable unless a typed display field is added.

options.title: Accept Localized Display Fields
options.body: Allow locale-dependent gateway message/reason strings and rely on stable code/type fields as the supported client contract.

options.title: Pause Runtime I18n Scope
options.body: Pause this broad runtime/gateway localization until maintainers define the supported runtime i18n boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep Gateway Fields Stable
recommendation.body: Localize chat/UI display copy while keeping gateway JSON message/reason strings stable unless a typed display field is added.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc merged the overlapping billing-copy behavior and is the strongest current routing candidate for the provider/runtime compatibility decision.
